notes.model: A break applies when a package moves from a version below `since` to one at or above it (or back). `old` patterns are the API of versions below `since`; `new` patterns the API from `since` on. Regexes run on comment-stripped source text; `requires` must also match in the same file. `kind` removed means the old API no longer exists (error when the new version is installed), deprecated means it still runs with warnings. `verified: false` on a break or a pattern marks facts not confirmed against the listed sources: they are reported as warnings only.
notes.check: `check: false` keeps a break out of `api/migration-required` because another rule already owns it; it still annotates version changes and upgrade plans.

breaks.title: PnPjs 2: selective imports and factory functions
steps: Import each feature you use: import "@pnp/sp/webs"; import "@pnp/sp/lists"; import "@pnp/sp/items"; (or import { sp } from "@pnp/sp/presets/all" to start).
Classes became factories: import { Web, IWeb } from "@pnp/sp/webs"; const web: IWeb = Web(url); (no `new`).
@pnp/sp-taxonomy and @pnp/sp-clientsvc are no longer provided; read taxonomy through @pnp/sp/taxonomy (2.0.6+).
Interfaces are prefixed with I (IWeb, IList, IItems); query chains starting from sp are unchanged.

old.what: class import from the @pnp/sp root: v2 exports factories from sub-modules such as @pnp/sp/webs
`new Web(...)`: v2 uses factory functions without `new`
@pnp/sp-taxonomy and @pnp/sp-clientsvc are not provided in v2

new.what: selective import from a @pnp/sp or @pnp/graph sub-module (v2+)

breaks.title: PnPjs 3: spfi()/graphfi() instances, @pnp/core and @pnp/queryable, invokable queries
steps: Replace the global `sp` object and `sp.setup({ spfxContext })` with an instance: import { spfi, SPFx } from "@pnp/sp"; const sp = spfi().using(SPFx(this.context)); (graph: graphfi().using(SPFx(context))).
Rename packages: @pnp/common -> @pnp/core, @pnp/odata -> @pnp/queryable; @pnp/sp-commonjs, @pnp/graph-commonjs, @pnp/sp-addinhelpers and @pnp/config-store are dropped.
Call queryables instead of .get(): sp.web.lists.getByTitle("x").items() instead of .items.get().
Batching: import "@pnp/sp/batching"; const [batchedSP, execute] = sp.batched(); queue calls on batchedSP, then await execute() (createBatch/inBatch are gone).

Renamed methods: getFolderByServerRelativeUrl -> getFolderByServerRelativePath, getFileByServerRelativeUrl -> getFileByServerRelativePath, folders.add/files.add -> addUsingPath, copyTo/moveTo -> copyByPath/moveByPath, search.execute -> search.run.
Logging listeners are factories: ConsoleListener() instead of new ConsoleListener(); ITypedHash is Record<string, T>.

old.what: global `sp`/`graph` object import: v3 creates instances with spfi()/graphfi()
sp.setup({ spfxContext }): v3 configures an instance with .using(SPFx(context))
.get() on a PnPjs queryable: v3 invokes the queryable as a function
@pnp/common and @pnp/odata were renamed to @pnp/core and @pnp/queryable
createBatch()/inBatch(): v3 batches with sp.batched() from @pnp/sp/batching
getFolderByServerRelativeUrl/getFileByServerRelativeUrl and folders.add/files.add were replaced by *ByServerRelativePath and addUsingPath
ITypedHash was removed; use Record<string, T>
@pnp/*-commonjs, @pnp/sp-addinhelpers and @pnp/config-store are not published for v3
logging listeners are factory functions in v3 (drop `new`)
.usingCaching(): v3 uses .using(Caching()) from @pnp/queryable

breaks.title: PnPjs 4: async iterators replace getAll/getPaged, add/update return the payload
steps: Replace items.getAll()/getPaged() and the @pnp/sp/items/get-all import with the async iterator: for await (const page of sp.web.lists.getByTitle("x").items.top(500)) { ... } (@pnp/graph: .paged() too).
add()/update() no longer return { data, item }: add() returns the created object (newItem.Id instead of newItem.data.Id); update() returns void, read the item again if you need it.
Taxonomy moved to @pnp/graph/taxonomy; @pnp/sp/favorites is removed (use graph favorites).
@pnp/graph: GraphQueryableCollection/GraphQueryableInstance are GraphCollection/GraphInstance; @pnp/graph/onedrive is @pnp/graph/files and @pnp/graph/outlook is @pnp/graph/mail.
Node 18 or newer is required to run the library outside the browser; @pnp/msaljsclient uses @azure/msal-browser 3.

old.what: items.getAll() and @pnp/sp/items/get-all were removed in v4 (async iterator)
items.getPaged() and PagedItemCollection were removed in v4 (async iterator)
graph collection .paged() was removed in v4 (async iterator)
add()/update() results with .data/.item: v4 returns the payload (add) or void (update)
@pnp/sp/taxonomy was removed in v4; use @pnp/graph/taxonomy
@pnp/sp/favorites was removed in v4; use graph favorites
@pnp/graph/onedrive and @pnp/graph/outlook are @pnp/graph/files and @pnp/graph/mail in v4
GraphQueryableCollection/GraphQueryableInstance are GraphCollection/GraphInstance in v4

new.what: async iteration over a PnPjs collection (v4)

breaks.title: React 16: PropTypes, createClass and addons left the core package
steps: React.PropTypes -> import PropTypes from 'prop-types'.
React.createClass -> import createReactClass from 'create-react-class'.
React.DOM -> react-dom-factories; react-addons-test-utils -> react-dom/test-utils; shallow renderer -> react-test-renderer/shallow.
react/lib/* and react-dom/lib/* internals no longer exist; unstable_handleError is componentDidCatch.

old.what: React.PropTypes was removed in 16 (prop-types package)
React.createClass was removed in 16 (create-react-class package)
react-addons-* and react/lib internals are not shipped with React 16

breaks.title: React 18: createRoot replaces ReactDOM.render
steps: import { createRoot } from 'react-dom/client'; const root = createRoot(container); root.render(<App />); keep the root in a field.
unmountComponentAtNode(container) -> root.unmount(); hydrate -> hydrateRoot.
The render callback is gone: run the code in a useEffect of the rendered component.
@types/react 18: declare children?: React.ReactNode explicitly in props (codemod: npx types-react-codemod).

old.what: ReactDOM.render/hydrate/unmountComponentAtNode run in React 17 mode under React 18 and are removed in React 19

breaks.title: React 19: the legacy ReactDOM.render API is removed
steps: Move every ReactDOM.render/hydrate/unmountComponentAtNode call to the react-dom/client root API before upgrading.

old.what: ReactDOM.render/hydrate/unmountComponentAtNode/findDOMNode are removed in React 19 (not verified against the upgrade guide)

breaks.title: Fluent UI React 8: office-ui-fabric-react and @uifabric/* were renamed to @fluentui/*
steps: Replace office-ui-fabric-react with @fluentui/react in package.json and in every import (import { Button } from '@fluentui/react'); remove the office-ui-fabric-react dependency so only one copy is bundled.

Rename @uifabric/* imports to their @fluentui/* packages (for example @uifabric/utilities -> @fluentui/utilities, @uifabric/react-hooks -> @fluentui/react-hooks, @uifabric/styling -> @fluentui/style-utilities).
Fabric and Customizer are deprecated: wrap the tree in ThemeProvider.
Several components became function components: class extension, findDOMNode and reading component state are no longer supported.

old.what: office-ui-fabric-react import: the package is @fluentui/react from version 8
@uifabric/* packages were moved to the @fluentui scope
Fabric and Customizer are deprecated in favour of ThemeProvider

breaks.title: Microsoft Graph JavaScript client 2: ImplicitMSALAuthenticationProvider and no bundled polyfills
steps: MSALAuthenticationProvider is ImplicitMSALAuthenticationProvider and takes an MSAL UserAgentApplication instance plus MSALAuthenticationProviderOptions.
Fetch and Promise polyfills are no longer bundled; graph-js-sdk-web.js and graph-js-sdk-core.js became graph-js-sdk.js.
Callbacks no longer receive the raw response: use .responseType(ResponseType.RAW).

old.what: MSALAuthenticationProvider was renamed to ImplicitMSALAuthenticationProvider in 2.0
graph-js-sdk-web.js and graph-js-sdk-core.js are not shipped from 2.0

breaks.title: Microsoft Graph JavaScript client 3: implicit-flow provider removed
steps: ImplicitMSALAuthenticationProvider and MSALAuthenticationProviderOptions are removed: use AuthCodeMSALBrowserAuthenticationProvider (@azure/msal-browser) or a custom authentication provider.
The timeout option of FetchOptions is gone: cancel requests with an AbortSignal.
LargeFileUploadTask takes a FileObject that implements sliceFile (FileUpload or StreamUpload); graph-es-sdk.js is no longer shipped.

old.what: ImplicitMSALAuthenticationProvider and MSALAuthenticationProviderOptions were removed in 3.0

breaks.title: SPFx 1.15: MSGraphClientV3 replaces MSGraphClient
steps: import { MSGraphClientV3 } from '@microsoft/sp-http'; and request it with this.context.msGraphClientFactory.getClient('3').
MSGraphClientV3 wraps @microsoft/microsoft-graph-client 3; review callback signatures and auth providers accordingly.

old.what: MSGraphClient / getClient() without a version wrap Graph client 1 and are replaced by MSGraphClientV3 / getClient('3')

breaks.title: SPFx 1.24: the gulp toolchain is not supported, builds run on Heft
steps: Remove gulpfile.js, @microsoft/sp-build-web and gulp; add @rushstack/heft and @microsoft/spfx-web-build-rig with config/rig.json (packman upgrade writes these).
Port custom gulp tasks to Heft plugins; scripts become heft build / heft start / heft package-solution --production.

old.what: gulpfile.js with @microsoft/sp-build-web: the gulp toolchain is not supported on SPFx 1.24

breaks.title: PnP reusable controls 2: SPFx 1.11, React 16.8.5, Fabric 6, SharePoint Online only
steps: Version 2 targets SharePoint Framework 1.11 and SharePoint Online only; keep 1.x for on-premises.
Align react/react-dom to 16.8.5, @types/react 16.8.8 and office-ui-fabric-react 6.214.0 (or the versions your SPFx release pins).
PeoplePicker: isRequired is now required; errorMessage is a static message and onGetErrorMessage validates dynamically.

old.what: PeoplePicker isRequired was renamed to required in controls 2

breaks.title: PnP reusable controls 3: SPFx 1.12 and Fluent UI 7
steps: Version 3 requires SharePoint Framework 1.12.1 or newer and Fluent UI 7 (@fluentui/react 7 / office-ui-fabric-react 7); later 3.x lines follow newer SPFx minors (spfx/library-target-mismatch).
Upgrade the SPFx project first (packman upgrade), then move the controls to the line built for that SPFx version.
